## PRB1.5. Capacity

-   FABEC registered 1.67 minutes of average en route ATFM delay per flight during 2025, thus not achieving the local target value of 0.63. Delays in FABEC decreased by -0.01 minutes per flight year-on-year.

-   The shortfall is attributable to Germany and France; the other FABEC States (and MUAC) met their local target.

-   Delays were highest in June, July and August, mostly driven by ATC capacity and weather.
